the Internet has not been fully exploited by Ghanaian NTEs for their international operations, and that this is a challenge for the Ghana Export Promotion Council (GEPC) and other stakeholders to address.

the Internet is an effective tool for information search and for the dissemination of information, but it is not yet being used for payments and other value chain activities.
